## RAG - Ingest (RFC-099)

**Endpoint:** POST /webhook/rag-ingest

**Description:** Ingestion RAG conforme RFC-099.
Reçoit les requêtes de MCP après authentification Bearer.
Vérifie la signature HMAC, extrait le contenu, chunke, vectorise (text-embedding-3-small 1536d)
et upsert dans Qdrant avec 4 IDs d'isolation (tenant_id, guild_id, bot_id, active).

**Payload entrant (§3.2 RFC-099):**
```json
{
  "source_id": "src_xxx",
  "tenant_id": "Z6F3GSWB",
  "guild_id": "1286607696153546774",
  "bot_id": "987654321",
  "active": true,
  "b2_file_key": "tenant/rag/file.pdf",
  "url": "https://example.com/doc.pdf",
  "file_type": "pdf",
  "extraction_method": "pdfplumber",
  "title": "Document Title",
  "lang": "fr",
  "callback_urls": {
    "progress": "https://api/sources/{id}/progress",
    "complete": "https://api/sources/{id}/complete",
    "error": "https://api/sources/{id}/error"
  },
  "qdrant_target": {
    "host": "host3.local",
    "port": 20001,
    "api_key": "..."
  }
}
```

**Headers requis:**
- `X-Webhook-Signature: sha256={hmac}` (HMAC-SHA256 du body)
- `Content-Type: application/json`

**Pipeline:**
1. Vérification HMAC (N8N_RAG_WEBHOOK_SECRET)
2. Validation payload
3. Callback progress (10%)
4. Fetch + Extract (B2 ou URL)
5. Callback progress (50%)
6. Chunking (1000 chars, overlap 200)
7. Callback progress (70%)
8. Embedding OpenAI text-embedding-3-small (1536d, batch 50)
9. Upsert Qdrant collection tenant_{tenant_id}_default avec 4 IDs
10. Callback complete

**Qdrant payload chunk (§5.1):**
```json
{
  "text": "...",
  "source_id": "src_xxx",
  "chunk_index": 0,
  "title": "Document Title",
  "source_type": "pdf",
  "lang": "fr",
  "tenant_id": "Z6F3GSWB",
  "guild_id": "1286607696153546774",
  "bot_id": "987654321",
  "active": true
}
```
